title: Small etale integral constructible internal Hom
statement: For a finite-type scheme X over a field k [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and a complete Noetherian domain R with principal ideal I=(v) generated by a nonzerodivisor and finite R/I of exponent invertible on k, the internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] of two integral bounded constructible complexes [def-weil-derived-complete, def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-kun-tor-amplitude] on the small etale site [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is integral bounded constructible. Its reduction modulo each I^n is isomorphic to the restriction of scalars of the internal Hom of any universal derived reductions. If their underlying R-reductions have common Tor intervals [a,b] and [c,e] and dim X <= d [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], its underlying R-reductions have Tor interval [c-b-2d,e-a+2d].

source.place: completeness and reduction comparison in sentence 1, finite-level estimate in sentences 2-3, integral membership in the final sentence; small etale constant-coefficient specialization

proof.text: The proved source derivedComplete_derivedHom gives completeness of the ambient internal Hom from completeness of L. The proved small etale Hom reduction theorem gives all universal finite-level comparisons, including n=0.

Choose one natural dimension bound by finiteness of the dimension of X over k. Extract uniform input intervals from integral constructibility. Apply integralFiniteHomEstimate at each level to get constructibility and the output Tor bound. With ambient completeness these form integral constructibility.

For arbitrary supplied dimension and input Tor intervals, use the same finite-level estimate and comparison, and project its Tor-amplitude conclusion. This proves the quantitative clause independently of the intervals chosen for integral membership.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedConstructibleIntegral_derivedHom {X : Scheme.{u}} (aX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aX] [QuasiCompact aX] {K L : 𝐃(X, Λ)}
    (hK : DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleIntegral I X K)
    (hL : DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleIntegral I X L) :
    DerivedCategory.boundedConstructibleIntegral I X
        (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj (op K)).obj L) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (Kn Ln : 𝐃(X, Λ ⧸ I ^ n))
        (η : K ⟶ (derivedRestrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) X).obj Kn)
        (η' : L ⟶ (derivedRestrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) X).obj Ln),
        IsDerivedBaseChange η → IsDerivedBaseChange η' →
          Nonempty ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ n)).obj
              (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj (op K)).obj L) ≅
            (derivedRestrictScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ n)) X).obj
              (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Λ ⧸ I ^ n)) X).obj (op Kn)).obj Ln))) ∧
      ∀ d : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) → ∀ a b c e : ℤ,
        (∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X a b
          ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ (n + 1))).obj K)) →
        (∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X c e
          ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ (n + 1))).obj L)) →
        ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X
          (c - b - 2 * (d : ℤ)) (e - a + 2 * (d : ℤ))
          ((reductionModIdeal Λ X (I ^ (n + 1))).obj
            (((derivedHom (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).obj (op K)).obj L))
